articles.summary: MONDOVI, Wis., July 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) announced today it has entered into an agreement to sell assets related to its intermodal business to Hub Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HUBG). articles.title: MARTEN TRANSPORT ANNOUNCES SALE OF ASSETS RELATED TO INTERMODAL BUSINESS
